sharedDrawing: CHSceneVisuals uses the existing DmSkin palette, halo strokes, anchor discs and pill labels
shiftRules: Open first point prepends; other points insert after the source; closed seam is supported. Shift is captured at mouse-down; at least 4 GUI points of movement starts duplication.
cancel: Escape or Ctrl/Cmd+Z during a drag, selection change, measurement activation, lost input, closed Scene view, assembly reload and Play mode cancel active editing; returning a new point to its source cancels the empty extension.
limits: Editor interaction tested on Windows D3D11 in the two recorded Unity versions.
Direct point movement uses a camera-facing plane or the existing optional downward surface snap; use selected-point gizmos for axis/depth adjustment.
Static generated models/meshes require explicit rebuild. Shift editing intentionally changes the curve; Ctrl insertion still preserves it.

measurementHarness.note: The existing measurement fixture did not resume automatically through delayCall after the first Unity 2022 script reload. Its pre-reload assertions and saved fixture state were preserved. A helper in the isolated test project resumed the original assertions through EditorApplication.update after a fresh real assembly reload. Unity 6 used the same update continuation from the start. No packaged C# or measurement assertions were changed.
